snippet.title: Aztecs: The Last Sun - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the Aztecs: The Last Sun trailer for this city-building strategy and city manager game. The trailer showcases features of Aztecs: The Last Sun, including your objectives like assigning jobs, creating production chains, and much more. In Aztecs: The Last Sun, become a ruler of the great city-state of Tenochtitlan. Develop a city, build an army. Let your people flow in riches!

Aztecs: The Last Sun will be available on PC. A new demo for Aztecs: The Last Sun is out now on Steam.

#Gaming #Games
